isolated_process_boundary: load exactly one comparison-system package including required hybrid models
one warm-up inference for every unique model required by that system
reset CUDA peak-memory counters where supported; Linux peak RSS is process-lifetime and cannot be reset
one measured inference for every unique model required by that system
measure controller mappings on the measured inference outputs
record process peak RSS and CUDA peak memory if CUDA is available

latency_components.ADB_actuation_latency: wall-clock temporal_smooth_schedule plus apply_actuation_rate_limit calls inside the exact frozen ADB mapping
latency_components.ADB_generation_latency: system-specific ADB branch wall-clock excluding neural direct-ADB encode/decode and excluding temporal smoothing/rate-limit actuation calls
latency_components.beam_probing_latency: physical probe count from frozen Stage5 actual_probe_count_for_adaptive_decision times frozen Tbeam=10 microseconds, reported for all four frozen horizons
latency_components.beam_selection_latency: primary 32-beam posterior/direct/deterministic probability-to-adaptive-q0.95 decision mapping; direct-beam neural forward excluded here and counted under predictor inference
latency_components.predictor_inference_time: sum of all unique neural forwards required by the comparison system; CUDA synchronized immediately before/after every timed GPU region
latency_components.preprocessing_latency: causal Stage2/Stage4 input construction, map context, actor boxes, association, receiver selection, normalization, and current reactive ADB map
latency_components.total_frame_latency: data_loading + preprocessing + tracking + predictor_inference + beam_selection + beam_probing + ADB_generation + ADB_actuation
latency_components.tracking_latency: 0.0 because Stage7 consumes frozen WOMD actor tracks and has no separate online tracker in this comparison boundary

latency_sensitivity.baseline: new measured per-system primary total-frame latency
latency_sensitivity.semantics: offline runtime sensitivity only; no controller/model outcome rerun and no annotated millisecond WOMD GT

measurement_scenario_rule.reason: deterministic receiver-evaluable input without outcome-based timing cherry-picking
measurement_scenario_rule.rule: first formal scenario in frozen Stage7 order whose frozen C1 causal lock has a non-null selected receiver

output_identity_gate.ADB: measured ADB schedule must be exactly np.array_equal to the corresponding frozen C1 NPZ schedule; direct_beam hybrid compares against shared ADB alias
output_identity_gate.communication: measured controller output must byte-canonically equal the corresponding frozen C1 communication output for the selected scenario; direct_ADB hybrid compares against the frozen shared communication branch
output_identity_gate.purpose: performance measurement cannot silently change controller semantics

primary_summary_rule.reason: conservative preregistered summary; no post-measurement horizon selection
primary_summary_rule.total_frame_latency_summary: maximum total-frame latency across the four frozen prediction horizons; all four horizon-specific totals are retained

purpose: Close the remaining Stage-7 PDF latency/resource requirements without modifying any frozen C1/C2/C3 scientific outcome.

resources.FLOPs: numeric only if exact/computable under the installed frozen runtime; otherwise explicit NOT_APPLICABLE_OR_NOT_EXACTLY_COMPUTABLE is acceptable per frozen Block7.5B
resources.memory: Linux fresh-process peak RSS; CUDA peak allocated/reserved also recorded where available but RSS is the primary cross-system memory metric
resources.parameter_count: unique trainable parameters of all neural models required by the system package; analytic mappings contribute zero trainable parameters

system_package_semantics.deterministic_shared_trajectory: one deterministic predictor + analytic communication + deterministic predictive ADB
system_package_semantics.direct_ADB_predictor: direct ADB field + one shared calibrated Gaussian predictor retained for communication
system_package_semantics.direct_beam_classifier: direct beam classifier + one shared calibrated Gaussian predictor retained for ADB
system_package_semantics.independent_models: two separately loaded calibrated Gaussian predictors; both parameter/inference costs counted
system_package_semantics.shared_trajectory_posterior: one shared calibrated Gaussian predictor + analytic communication + analytic ADB
